document_id: til 2511 - f.05 & ha compressor-section retention-key improvements

parsed_profile_json.title: F.05 & HA COMPRESSOR-SECTION RETENTION-KEY IMPROVEMENTS
parsed_profile_json.purpose:
To inform affected users about:
1. The potential for keys retaining sub-assemblies such as stator vane segments, inducer, high pressure packing seal, air-inducer seal, and/or casing treatment ring to overcome staked retention, which can result in object drops during casing lifts.
2. The availability of an improved key retention method, and the recommendation to install the improved key retention modification during a planned major inspection.
parsed_profile_json.compliance_category_text: Safety - Failure to comply with this TIL could result in personal injury. Compliance is mandated within a specific operating time.
scope_of_work: Machine threaded holes and counterbores on the UH compressor-section casings at the HJ to accept retention screws.
Install new keys to retain stator-vanes, HPPS, AIS1, inducer2, and CT ring3; torque retention screws to specification.
Stake around the keys at 4x places to serve as secondary retention.
service_recommendation_line_items: Apply the newly configured retention key modification at the next major inspection (MI) when all the compressor section upper-half (UH) casings will be removed.
Optionally apply the modification at an earlier opportunity, if all the affected compressor section UH casings are removed prior to an MI.

Prior to lifting any UH casing, take additional precautions and, if possible, inspect the retention keys for any potential abnormalities such as a displaced key; once the UH casing is separated, telescoping mirrors may be used to perform this inspection.
parsed_profile_json.completion_criteria_text: The TIL is considered as complete once the newly configured key retention modification is installed.
parsed_profile_json.maintenance_trigger_text: Next major inspection (MI) when all the compressor section upper-half (UH) casings will be removed; may optionally be applied at an earlier opportunity if all affected UH casings are removed prior to an MI.
recommended_interval_or_trigger: Apply the newly configured retention key modification at the next major inspection (MI) when all the compressor section upper-half (UH) casings will be removed.
Optionally apply at an earlier opportunity if all the affected compressor section UH casings are removed prior to an MI.
parsed_profile_json.frame_or_model_applicability_text: Applicable to all 7F.04-200, 7F.05, 7HA.01, 7HA.02, 7HA.03, 9F.05-18, 9HA.01, and 9HA.02 gas turbines.
parsed_profile_json.hardware_or_part_configuration_text: Retention keys in the upper-half (UH) compressor-section casings retain stator vane segments, seals (high-pressure packing seal (HPPS) and aft inducer seal (AIS)), inducer, and casing treatment (CT) ring. AIS is installed only on HA.0x units. Inducer is installed only on HA.0x units with a double-wall compressor discharge casing. CT ring is installed only on 7HA.03 units.
parsed_profile_json.exclusions_or_non_applicable_conditions_: AIS, inducer, and CT ring are installed only on specific gas turbine models (AIS only on HA.0x units; inducer only on HA.0x units with a double-wall compressor discharge casing; CT ring only on 7HA.03 units).
parsed_profile_json.prerequisite_outage_or_inspection_contex: Planned major inspection (MI) when all compressor section upper-half (UH) casings will be removed; earlier opportunity possible if all affected UH casings are removed prior to an MI. Prior to lifting any UH casing, inspect retention keys for abnormalities if possible; once UH casing is separated, telescoping mirrors may be used.

source_snippets.snippet: The potential for keys retaining sub-assemblies such as stator vane segments, inducer, high pressure packing seal, air-inducer seal, and/or casing treatment ring to overcome staked retention, which can result in object drops during casing lifts.

If the retention stakes are not adequately applied, there is potential for keys and the sub-assemblies, such as stator vane segments, inducer, and seals to drop during UH casing lifts, which can lead to personnel injury.

It is recommended that the newly configured retention key modification be applied to the unit at the next major inspection (MI) when all the compressor section upper-half (UH) casings will be removed.
The modification may optionally be applied at an earlier opportunity, if all the affected compressor section UH casings are removed prior to an MI.
Machine threaded holes and counterbores on the UH compressor-section casings at the HJ to accept retention screws.
Install new keys to retain stator-vanes, HPPS, AIS1, inducer2, and CT ring3; torque retention screws to specification.
Stake around the keys at 4x places to serve as secondary retention.
The TIL is considered as complete once the newly configured key retention modification is installed.
This TIL is applicable to all 7F.04-200, 7F.05, 7HA.01, 7HA.02, 7HA.03, 9F.05-18, 9HA.01, and 9HA.02 gas turbines.

AIS is installed only on HA.0x units.
2 Inducer is installed only on HA.0x units with a double-wall compressor discharge casing.
3 CT ring is installed only on 7HA.03 units.
